title: Focus Management Architecture: Traps, Restoration & Roving Tabindex
subtopicTitle: Focus Management Architecture: Traps, Restoration & Roving Tabindex
problemStatement:
Managing keyboard focus across modals, drawers, dropdowns, and menus with focus trapping and focus restoration.

**Enterprise Importance**:
Keyboard traps and lost focus after closing modals are among the top accessibility audit failures that lead to lawsuits and broken user experiences.
interviewTrap: Failing to restore focus to the trigger button when a modal or drawer unmounts, dumping the user at the top of the body.

detailedExplanation.conceptualOverview: When a modal opens, trap focus within its boundary by cycling Tab from last element to first. When the modal closes, restore focus back to the exact element that triggered it.
stepByStepWalkthrough: 1. Design Token Layer: Primitives, semantic aliases, and component tokens established.
2. Component Architecture: Headless state and keyboard accessibility hooks implemented.
3. Styling & Cascade: Zero-runtime CSS variables and layer specificity managed.
4. Governance & Packaging: Tree-shaking, semantic versioning, and telemetry monitored.

complexity.time: O(1) CSS variable resolution at paint time / zero JavaScript runtime overhead
